_how: Copy to ict/config-us-futures.json in the folder you work from, then edit. Every key is optional.
_profitable: Notes EP-7: risk 1% or half a % until profitability. While false, risk is capped at unprofitable_risk_pct.
_size_factor: Psychology #9: lower size by 1/4 until it feels comfortable -> 0.75.
_events: Fill in this month's red-folder dates from an economic calendar. action avoid = no trades (CPI), conviction = allowed with a warning (FOMC). These two dates are examples only.
